text:
Aisha CSM: Morning — kicking off the Vellum Health onboarding thread. TL;DR: we need stakeholder rollcall, confirmation of success criteria, training windows, and any early renewal risk flags. Can folks drop availability and owners?

Jon SE: Hi — happy to own the technical onboarding. I can lead the sandbox provisioning and model mapping. Available Mon/Wed afternoons next week.

Liam (Eng): I can join for the infra handoff and SLA discussion. Need to know if they require Dedicated or Private for pilot (regulatory). Available Tue morning.

Priya (Success Ops): I'll run enablement + training. Proposing 2 x 90m sessions: one for admins, one for devs. Suggested dates: 2025-04-08 & 2025-04-10. Also capturing success metrics: 1) integrated API calls per day, 2) latency <= 350ms p95 for core routes, 3) first successful prod samples by day 21.

Aisha CSM: Great — thanks. Vellum Health stakeholders: Sarah (CTO), Marco (Prod), Elena (Security). Sarah flagged potential PHI concerns — likely needs Private deployment or strict VPC with KMS. Marco wants a pilot with 5k monthly calls target.

Jon SE: On sandbox — I'll share a quick checklist for test data and sample prompts. Putting it here for visibility:
```
- Create sandbox org in console
- Upload sample dataset (anonymized)
- Assign API keys for devs
- Enable prefix caching for test routes
```
I'll post the template by EOD.

Liam (Eng): Re: PHI, suggest we prep an architecture options doc (Private vs VPC + HSM). I'll draft and share Thursday. If they go Private, lead time is ~3 weeks for infra prep.

Priya (Success Ops): Noted on PHI. For training, do we want pre-read? I can assemble a 15m pre-record and two workshop agendas. Also recommend we collect 10 evaluation prompts from Marco to baseline quality.

Aisha CSM: Action items and owners:
- Aisha: coordinate stakeholder sync and confirm pilot KPIs with Sarah (due 2025-04-03)
- Jon SE: sandbox checklist + sample prompts (due 2025-04-02)
- Liam (Eng): architecture options doc + lead time estimate (due 2025-04-04)
- Priya: training pre-read + workshop agendas + prompt collection template (due 2025-04-05)

onboarding-bot: Reminder set — follow-up in 3 days for progress updates. :spiral_calendar: 

Aisha CSM: One risk to flag: if PHI requires on-prem Private, pilot start could slip by 2–3 weeks. Marking that as renewal-risk watch; we'll escalate to sales if lead time impacts committed go-live.

Jon SE: Quick Q — who will own redaction/anonymization of datasets?

Priya (Success Ops): Vellum said they will provide anonymized samples, but we should validate. I can add a checklist item for data validation in the sandbox runbook.

Aisha CSM: Perfect. If no objections, I'll schedule the stakeholder sync for 2025-04-03 16:00 PT and send calendar invites. Please react with :thumbsup: if that works or suggest alternate times.

Liam (Eng): :thumbsup: works for me.

Jon SE: :thumbsup:

Priya (Success Ops): Works. I'll prepare enablement notes ahead.

Aisha CSM: Thanks team — will update thread after invites.
